prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one isolated source image for an image-to-3D building in a children's toy-town game.
Create a beautifully crafted miniature MUSIC CLUB matching the supplied accepted town concept and bakery material reference. Image 1 supplies identity: the teal club with a large golden star on its curved central facade, on the right of the canal below the purple toy shop. Image 2 supplies ONLY material quality and scale of details: substantial softly rounded forms, clean bevels, tactile painted toy surfaces, cream trims. Do not reproduce the bakery, its striped awning, oven, or base slab.
Subject: a compact single-storey music hall with a taller central rounded Art Deco parapet. Teal/turquoise walls, warm ivory corner columns and parapet trim, deep blue opaque double entrance doors with two simple brass handles. One large raised golden five-point star centered high on the teal front parapet, matte painted and NOT glowing. A shallow solid coral-red curved canopy immediately above the doorway, with restrained small gold stud details. Short side wings each have one broad cream-framed opaque blue window. Clear expressive silhouette, joyful and welcoming, no tiny ornament.
CRITICAL roof: the entire building has a continuous solid opaque gently curved blue-green roof behind the facade, visible from the elevated view. It must be a closed building, never an open courtyard, roof hole, cutaway, transparent roof, glass pavilion or hollow shell. The central facade is taller than the side wings but not a second storey. Target full building width:depth:height approximately 7:5.2:5.0. Keep roof eaves and doorway canopy shallow, so children and separate gameplay devices in front remain visible. Door flush at ground level; no stairs, platform or plinth. All windows are opaque coloured toy glass; no interior.
Composition: one complete building centered on a plain warm off-white studio background, three-quarter front/right view from moderate elevation showing the closed roof and front entrance. Entire model visible, generous unclipped margins. Even soft studio light, gentle contact shadow only, rich clean colours, no dramatic dark shadows. Premium sculpted 3D toy render, not procedural primitive geometry, not a flat illustration.
Exclude: people, dancers, musical instruments, speakers, separate neon sign, wires, lamps, plants, trees, fences, pavements, courtyard, roads, base slab, steps, lettering, words, numerals, logos, watermark. The working neon sign, sensor and music box will be separate game objects, so do not attach or depict them. Only one static golden star is the club's pictorial emblem.
mode: built-in image_gen; references supply building identity and material style
status: First club reference for Claude review; no Tripo order
inspection: One storey with raised central star facade, opaque roof, shallow coral canopy, flush ground door. No people, steps, plinth, text or attached gameplay devices. PNG does not establish dimensions, hidden roof topology or gameplay visibility.
